name: Mantissa
search: Midge Mantissa Sinnaeve artist director VFX
dek: Midge “Mantissa” Sinnaeve works where CG, cinema, animation and live visuals collapse into one image-making practice.
body: Mantissa’s work moves between opening titles, music visuals, VFX, live events and self-initiated experiments without treating those formats as separate worlds.
His portfolio describes an approach built from animation, VFX, design and direction, with credits ranging from title work to 3D VFX for Korn.
The recurring idea is control over atmosphere: 3D becomes camera, lighting system and world-building device at once.

name: Vincent Langaard
dek: Pop mythology, western imagery and cultural symbols collide in Vincent Langaard’s image-heavy practice.
body: Vincent Langaard’s catalogue moves through recurring visual worlds rather than a single neat series.
The work treats recognisable imagery as raw material, repeating and reframing familiar icons into a personal visual system.
His site groups the work into bodies including Liquid Metal, West World, Mythos and Reality Is Just a Collective Hunch.

name: Archive42
dek: A Graz-based design studio working across identity, motion, 3D, web, film, print and spatial applications.
body: Archive42 works across identity, motion, 3D image-making, web, film, photography, print and spatial applications.
Its strength is in treating those disciplines as one system rather than isolated services.
This feature is part of DDN’s rotating studio index and is not independent third-party press coverage.

name: Lake Hills
search: Lake Hills audiovisual artist DJ producer
dek: An audiovisual practice where electronic music, live performance and moving image are developed together.
body: Lake Hills sits in a part of electronic culture where sound and image are not separate deliverables.
His practice extends from music production into audiovisual performance and visual systems built for other artists.
The result is part producer, part visual artist and part live-performance world builder.

name: Sarah Sprosec
dek: An Austrian designer added to DDN’s growing index of regional and independent creative practices.
body: DDN is not only interested in large international studios; smaller and regional practices matter too.
Sarah Sprosec enters the index as part of that wider Austrian design context.
This profile stays intentionally concise until more primary-source project material is available.
